prompt: My new employer is offering an HDHP with an HSA or a traditional PPO. I have asthma and take daily medication. How do I decide?
expected: Treat daily medication as recurring cost; pull plan-year HSA/HDHP limits from cost-model/sources; ask employer HSA contribution and drug tier on both plans; compare expected and high-use paths.
actual: Structural dry-run 2026-10-11: cost-model.md table includes 2024–2026 IRS limits with Rev. Proc. citations; Rule 4 requires source refresh; formulary/network checks appear in Rules 3 and 5. Pass on structure; dollar advice still requires live IRS confirm at answer time.

prompt: Open Enrollment is next week. What exact steps should I take after I pick a plan, and what proof should I keep?
